question: Where can I get the railway network (geometry) of Spain, with line type, electrification, infrastructure manager and traffic?

answer.summary: Geometry with electrification, gauge and track count for the whole network (Adif plus FGC, Euskotren, SFM, metro, tram) is in IGN's INSPIRE WFS (60,018 links, CC BY 4.0). Line type is partial (train/metro/tram on 497 lines). Manager is only an administration level there; ERA RINF gives a manager code for 2,520 Adif sections. Traffic exists only as train-km per axis and top-10 lines (CNMC PDF). Adif's own WFS is blocked to automated clients.
main_caveats: IGN attributes are separate features linked to links; many links lack electrification (38,120) or track count (37,336) of 60,018. GML only.
ERA RINF geometry is a 2-point chord per section and only manager code 0071; the code was not confirmed as Adif by any page.
Traffic is per axis and top-10 lines only, RFIG only (no FGC, Euskotren, SFM, metro or tram).
ideadif.adif.es, www.adif.es and www.transportes.gob.es answered 403 to automated clients; Adif's own WFS and network statement were not read.
Network lengths differ: Adif 15,654.1 km (OFE 2024), RFIG 15,678 km (CNMC 2025), RINF sections sum 15,537 km.
answer.confidence_reason: Geometry, electrification and RINF were tested live; traffic and manager rely on PDFs; Adif's primary services were blocked and Catalan/Basque catalogues not fully checked.

attributes.note: IGN WFS: 60,018 polylines, all managers. RINF has only 2-point chords per section.
RailwayType train 378, metro 65, tramway 45 on 497 lines; BOE blocks; Valencia tipo_linea. No Adif service-class type.
attributes.gap_note: Adif Declaración sobre la Red (line classification for fees) lives on adif.es, which returned 403; not opened.

attributes.note: IGN boolean on 38,120 links; RINF voltage per track (3 kV DC, 25 kV AC, 1.5 kV DC); BOE by line.
RINF: one manager code (0071) for Spain; OFE names Adif, ETS, FGC, SFM; Valencia titularidad. IGN gives owner level only.
attributes.gap_note: Per-segment manager for FGC, Euskotren and SFM links not found; Catalan and Basque IDE catalogues not rendered by my tools, ICGC not opened.

attributes.note: CNMC train-km per axis (12) and top-10 lines; OFE density trains/km/day. No per-segment dataset seen.
attributes.gap_note: Line-level occupancy in Adif's Declaración sobre la Red (adif.es 403) not read; CNMC Data API not explored.

example.example_request:
curl -sG --data-urlencode "query@rq.txt" -H "Accept: application/sparql-results+json" https://graph.data.era.europa.eu/repositories/rinf-plus   with rq.txt =
PREFIX era: <http://data.europa.eu/949/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#>
SELECT ?label ?im ?len ?cls ?wkt WHERE { ?s a era:SectionOfLine ; rdfs:label ?label ; era:inCountry <http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/country/ESP> ; era:infrastructureManager ?im ; era:lengthOfSectionOfLine ?len ; era:hasPart ?t ; era:netReference/geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?wkt . ?t era:contactLineSystem ?cls } LIMIT 2
